sites.enforcement_snippet:
if user_id != doc.owner_id and user_id not in doc.shared_with:
    raise UnauthorizedError(f"User {user_id} cannot edit doc {doc.id}")

domain_notes: edit_document permits an edit only for the owner or an explicitly shared user; a single combined guard enforces both. Both existing tests use authorized identities (owner, then a shared_with user); neither drives a third party who is neither owner nor shared, so the rejection path is untested.
rationale: Selected edit_document because its combined owner/shared guard is the sole enforcement and no test drives an unauthorized third party.
